mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may potentiate valbenazine's effects on QT prolongation and increase risk of arrhythmias; valbenazine is a weak CYP3A4 inhibitor that may modestly increase chlorthalidone exposure.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium) periodically; obtain baseline and follow-up ECGs; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte abnormalities develop.
